name: phone-tracker-replica
goal: Prove a paired phone can sync bounded Tracker deltas and query items, notes, flags and runs from SQLite after losing network and restarting.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Planned phone Tracker replica specification defines scoped pairing, projected delta and snapshot protocol, SQLite, background budgets, local tools, staged writes, and synthetic acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented versioned hub projection, paired-device read scope, protected SQLite storage, native model read tools, and foreground, BGTask and silent wake entry points.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Tracker pull red reproduced endpoint 404 first. Hub projection, encrypted device boundary, and native Debug (316) and Release (294) headless assertions passed locally. Simulator acceptance remains in verify.
